personality_one_liner: A cinematic, deeply atmospheric music player defined by pure liquid-glass surfaces, immersive artwork blur, and premium fluid transitions.

spacing.rule: Generous cinematic spacing. Use negative space to let the album artwork and liquid glass surfaces breathe. Minimum 24pt margins on cards.

do's: Use heavy liquid glass effects on the Now Playing screen, extracting album art colors as a full-bleed blurred background.
Apply a translucent frosted glass header and bottom tab bar over scrollable recommendation grids.
Use tinted translucency beneath white foreground text to guarantee 4.5:1 contrast over bright/busy album art (at least 70% opacity base under the blur).
Float the mini-player above the tab bar as a pill-shaped frosted glass container.
dont's: Don't apply glassmorphism to standard list items or dense library rows—reserve it for elevated surfaces like sheets, nav bars, and the main player canvas.
Don't stack more than two layers of blur on top of each other.
Don't sacrifice accessibility; always use a gradient-to-dark scrim or heavy black tinting underneath white lyrics/text on blurred backgrounds.

screens.name: Home / For You
screens.purpose: A lush, immersive discovery feed featuring oversized, edge-to-edge album artwork cards and curated genre rows.

states.loading: Cinematic skeleton screens featuring slow-pulsing dark gradients.
states.empty: A soft, deep-space gradient with a solitary 'Discover Music' icon and primary CTA.
states.error: Muted error state over a dark blur, with a subtle 'Retry Connection' glass button.

screens.layout: Grid-based with a large featured track at the top (hero card). Scrollable horizontal rows for 'Trending' and 'Recently Played'. The bottom tab bar is fully translucent, and the mini-player floats above it.

screens.name: Now Playing (Full Screen)
screens.purpose: The crown jewel of the app—an emotionally resonant playback canvas with massive album art and liquid-glass atmospheric lighting.

states.empty: N/A - Screen only accessible when a track exists.
states.error: Subtle toast notification for playback failure.

screens.layout: Full-bleed album art in the background with an intense blur radius (50-100) and a 40-70% dark tint overlay. The foreground features a crisp, rounded-corner album cover with a soft shadow, dropping down to cleanly spaced transport controls and a timeline slider. Swiping up seamlessly transitions to the Lyrics view.

screens.name: Lyrics Canvas
screens.purpose: A karaoke-style, line-by-line synced lyrics experience that floats over the dynamic album art blur.

states.empty: 'Instrumental' or 'Lyrics not available' text beautifully centered on the glass canvas.

screens.layout: Massive typography (using Geist) scrolling vertically. Active lyric line is 100% opacity white (scale slightly up), while inactive lines are 30-40% opacity white. The background remains the liquid-glass album artwork.

screens.name: Premium Equalizer
screens.purpose: An audiophile's control center for shaping sound, blending technical utility with premium aesthetics.
screens.layout: A dark, highly polished modal sheet. Top section contains a horizontal scrolling row of 'Presets' (Acoustic, Bass Booster, etc.) using glass chips. The main area features vertical sliders (rotated -90deg) grouped evenly. Active slider tracks glow with the `brandPrimary` color, while inactive tracks are muted dark grey. A subtle live-waveform visualizer sits at the very top.

hero_artwork_2.alt: Vibrant pink and violet geometric album cover

eq_background_texture.alt: Dark abstract liquid glass texture blur

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: The user explicitly requested a 'Dark liquid glass theme (primary), also support Light theme with a toggle'. Implement robust theme switching in the app shell, using the `_dark` appended tokens for the dark mode.
Implement the 'Now Playing' screen as a full-screen modal or dedicated route, where the background is an `expo-image` of the album cover wrapped in a heavy `expo-blur` (tint='dark', intensity=80+).

For the Equalizer screen, use vertical sliders. Since React Native doesn't have a native vertical slider, use `@react-native-community/slider` rotated via `transform: [{ rotate: '-90deg' }]` or implement a custom Reanimated pan gesture slider.
The Mini-Player must be a persistent glass pill positioned directly above the bottom tab bar, floating over the content. Use absolute positioning with an `expo-blur` background.

Lyrics Screen: Build a synced lyrics view where the active lyric line is highly opaque and slightly scaled, and inactive lines are faded. Ensure the scroll view auto-scrolls to the active line. Layer this entirely over the blurred artwork canvas.
NO BLUES rule strictly observed: The accent color is a premium Apple Music-inspired Ruby/Rose (`#E11D48` light, `#F43F5E` dark). Do not introduce navy or indigo anywhere.
Use 'Fraunces' for massive, cinematic screen titles, and 'Geist' for all functional UI, track lists, and lyrics to ensure maximum legibility against complex glass backgrounds.
